claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: This is a general business statement and cannot be confirmed by inspecting a single item.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical failure (seized engine or low compression).
risks.proof: A video of the engine being hand-cranked or a compression test report.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-running core for parts.

risks.risk: Transmission internal damage or gear failure.
risks.proof: A photo of the transmission fluid color/smell or a diagnostic scan from the donor vehicle.

risks.risk: Catalytic converters may be gutted or missing internal substrate.
risks.proof: A photo looking into the exhaust manifold to see the honeycomb structure.
risks.if_unproven: as having no scrap value for precious metals.

risks.risk: Electrical harness damage or missing sensors.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all wiring connectors and the ECU plug.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a complete harness replacement.

proof_requests: Photo of the engine model code or serial number stamped on the block.
The VIN of the vehicle this unit was pulled from.
Video showing the engine turning over.
Clear photos of the manufacturer's tags on the transmission.
response.reason: The specific brand and model of the engine are unidentified. In the Abuja market, value varies drastically between manufacturers, making even a worst-case price impossible to determine without identification.
